# criblio_search_usage_group (Data Source)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_search_usage_group" "my_search_usage_group" {
  id = "power_users"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this Usage Group.

### Read-Only

- `coordinator_heap_memory_limit` (Integer) Optional coordinator heap memory limit value when the deployment stores it at the group level (interpretation follows usage-group configuration and UI schemas).
- `description` (String) Brief description of the Usage Group.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables or disables the Usage Group.
- `rules` (Attributes) Limit Rules for this Usage Group, keyed by limit type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `users` (Attributes Map) Membership record for a user assigned to a Usage Group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))
- `users_count` (Integer) Count of members in the Usage Group.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `coordinator_heap_memory_limit` (Attributes) Maximum Coordinator heap memory, in bytes, available to a single search. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--coordinator_heap_memory_limit))
- `max_bytes_read_per_search` (Attributes) Maximum number of bytes that a single search can read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_bytes_read_per_search))
- `max_concurrent_adhoc_searches_per_user` (Attributes) Maximum number of ad hoc searches that a single user can run concurrently. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_concurrent_adhoc_searches_per_user))
- `max_concurrent_scheduled_searches_per_user` (Attributes) Maximum number of scheduled searches that a single user can run concurrently. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_concurrent_scheduled_searches_per_user))
- `max_concurrent_searches` (Attributes) Maximum number of concurrent searches across the entire organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_concurrent_searches))
- `max_executors_per_search` (Attributes) Maximum number of executors that can be allocated to a single search. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_executors_per_search))
- `max_relative_earliest_timerange` (Attributes) Limit on how far back from the present a search can read, in seconds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_relative_earliest_timerange))
- `max_results_per_search` (Attributes) Maximum number of events that a single search can return. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_results_per_search))
- `max_running_time_per_search` (Attributes) Maximum time, in seconds, that a single search can run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_running_time_per_search))
- `max_timerange_width` (Attributes) Maximum width of a search time range, in seconds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--max_timerange_width))

### Nested Schema for `rules.coordinator_heap_memory_limit`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Brief description of the rule.
- `limit` (Dynamic) Threshold for the rule. Accepts a number, or a string the API recognizes for this limit type, such as <code>"default"</code> for <code>coordinatorHeapMemoryLimit</code>.
- `metric` (String) Optional metric identifier aggregated for enforcement.
- `type` (String) Limit type.

### Nested Schema for `rules.max_concurrent_adhoc_searches_per_user`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Brief description of the rule.
- `limit` (Dynamic) Non-negative integer concurrent-search limit, or a percentage string.
- `metric` (String) Optional metric identifier aggregated for enforcement.
- `type` (String) Identifier for a scheduling-stage limit.

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address shown for the member in Usage Group administration. For an API credential, this reports who created it.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the member, representing a stable ID from the deployment identity system. API credential IDs end with <code>@clients</code>.
